name: details-target-reconciliation
body: The canonical rule for the `details` edge is that a Note target is excluded on both sides. The write surface refuses a `Note`→`Note` pair in the `details` arm of `rust.apg.layers.validate.validate_edge`; the load projection's `Details` target list (`rust.apg.load.tables.spec_rel_pairs`) omits `Note`. `requirements.requirement.details-target-set-consistency` (feature `durable-spec-integrity`), the entity `domain.entity.details-edge`, the law `domain.constraint.details-canonical-target-set`, and the component `solution.component.details-target-validation` state this rule; the component is `implemented-by` `rust.apg.layers.validate.validate_edge` alone. The projection stays unchanged. `rust.apg.load.tables.spec_rel_pairs` declares transient `Plan`/`PlanPhase`/`Task` targets too, and non-Note `details` targets stay unvalidated, since `rust.apg.layers.write.validate_change` scopes code-ref drift validation to `kind == "implemented-by"`. The `unit`-tier test `rust.apg.layers.tests.unit.details_accepts_any_target_and_enforces_note_source` (`src/layers/tests.rs:529-568`) stays in the `unit` submodule and is carried by the plan as a modify/rename task.
